title: A Spire for the Salt
author: Coral Coldharbour
blurb: Orsen Villalobos, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
